items.title: OpenAI Agents API
items.why: OpenAI is releasing a dedicated API for building AI agents, which is essential knowledge if you want to build agentic applications.
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced an official Agents API, giving developers standardized tools and endpoints to build autonomous AI workflows.

items.title: yudaprasetya007/routeVSCODE
items.why: If you use VS Code for your CS coursework, this tool lets you switch between different local and cloud AI models easily inside Copilot Chat.
items.summary: An open-source VS Code extension and proxy that enables dynamic, zero-reload switching between different AI models in Copilot Chat.

items.title: Vincentwei1021/anything2explainer
items.why: You can use this tool to quickly create narrated educational videos explaining complex computer science concepts.
items.summary: A coding skill tool that automatically converts text topics into motion-graphics explainer videos complete with AI voiceover and subtitles.

items.title: vinzdg/codenotch
items.why: This tool helps you monitor your usage limits across AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor directly on your screen.
items.summary: A lightweight macOS app that pins real-time usage and rate limits for popular AI coding assistants to the top edge of your desktop screen.

items.title: i-am-manware/Manware-s-AI-Learning-Toolkit
items.why: It turns AI coding assistants into patient tutors to help you learn programming rather than just giving raw code.
items.summary: An open-source toolkit designed to configure AI agents so they guide and teach developers instead of automatically generating code.

items.title: Python sets and dictionaries can have quadratic-time performance
items.why: Understanding when standard Python data structures perform slowly is a key concept for CS data structure classes and technical interviews.
items.summary: A technical discussion exploring how worst-case hash collisions in Python sets and dictionaries can degrade lookup performance from instant to slow quadratic time.

items.title: Rust is tier-1 language at Microsoft
items.why: Rust is increasingly becoming a critical systems programming language, and Microsoft's backing signals strong future job market demand.
items.summary: Microsoft has officially elevated Rust to a Tier-1 fully supported language for internal systems development and software engineering.

items.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
items.why: Understanding why major tech companies switch mobile tech stacks offers valuable insight into real-world software engineering tradeoffs.
items.summary: Shopify announced it is transitioning its mobile applications away from React Native back to native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development.

items.title: Shopify acquires Tailwind
items.why: Tailwind CSS is one of the most popular web development frameworks, so its acquisition by e-commerce giant Shopify is major tech news.
items.summary: Shopify has acquired Tailwind CSS, bringing the widely used utility-first CSS framework into its developer tools ecosystem.

items.title: LG defends smart-TV features amid audio surveillance allegations
items.why: It touches on key consumer privacy concerns regarding how smart devices collect and monitor audio data without clear user consent.
items.summary: LG responded to allegations that its smart TVs non-consensually monitor user audio to harvest personal viewer data.

items.title: Automattic's board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence
items.why: Automattic runs WordPress.com, which powers a massive portion of the web, making executive shifts there important web tech industry news.
items.summary: The board of directors at Automattic forced CEO Matt Mullenweg to take an indefinite leave of absence following recent company controversies.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
items.why: This is major geopolitical news impacting international shipping lanes and global trade in the Red Sea.
items.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces in Yemen have reportedly taken control of the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha near a critical shipping channel.

items.title: Russian strike hits shopping centre in central Ukraine
items.why: It covers significant developments in the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
items.summary: A Russian military strike on a shopping center in the Ukrainian city of Pavlohrad resulted in at least four civilian deaths.
